note: Both sets are nearly identical in content and quality, sharing the same claims about the VVC, the polarizers in the beam train, the telescope architecture, and the schematic layouts. Set B additionally includes the supported claim that higher topological charge yields a larger IWA, which Set A omits despite it being a key trade-off stated on the page. Both sets contain a duplicated VVC 'type' claim (phase-based coronagraph / phase-based) and a duplicated polarizer-in-beam-train claim, and both include label-only claims from the figures with trivial quotes. No claim in either set is misread or invented relative to the page text and figures.
remarks: The only differentiator is B's IWA-vs-topological-charge claim ('the higher the charge... the larger the IWA'), which is directly supported by the text and is an important design trade-off; A's omission of it counts against A. Both sets repeat the VVC type claim and the polarizer inclusion claim under two names. The 'Dichroic -> DM2 -> Polarizers -> Polarizers -> IFS' sequence in both sets compresses the schematic and skips the mask/stops/filter wheel/camera selector, so it reads as a loose ordering rather than a faithful path; it is shared, so it does not affect the comparison. Figure 5.5-15 label claims (CCD, DM1, DM2, IFS, OAP 5 in the blue channel) are supported by the image but stated with bare-label quotes.
